newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark mulls Portuguese GSM bid.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark mulls Portuguese GSM bid.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark said on Monday it was still considering a bid to join a mobile telephony consortium in Portugal.

"We are mulling whether or not we want to or have the resources to attempt to become a partner in a Portuguese mobile telephony consortium to bid for Portugal's third GSM licence," Tele Danmark project manager Torben Holm told Reuters.
"We will make our decision this week," he said.

The consortium is currently completely Portuguese, comprising Sonae Industria, EDP-Electricidade de Portugal and telecommunications group Maxitel, but it wants to allocate a 10-20 percent stake to a foreign partner, Holm said.
The Portuguese consortium previously said it was negotiating with eight foreign tele-operators including Tele Danmark and France Telecom.
Bidding for Portugal's third mobile telephone licence is due to start formally in mid-September.
